Title: Mode/profile ambiguity
Problem: Run mode, radio profile, scenario class, and validation class can be inferred independently in different layers.
RequiredFix: Create immutable RunMode and RadioProfile enums and one IntegrationPlanningResult. Every run must resolve exactly once before state or waveform creation.
Acceptance: Mode/profile resolution is identical in YAML, MATLAB runtime, artifacts, and WebGUI; unknown or conflicting values fail before execution.

Title: Parallel orchestration paths
Problem: Fixed-SNR and geometry scenarios can enter different runners and bypass different subsystems.
RequiredFix: Create one canonical IntegrationOrchestrator with environment adapters for FIXED_SNR_SWEEP and GEOMETRY_NETWORK.
Acceptance: Both modes produce the same common component registry and invoke the same PHY/waveform receiver implementation digests.

Title: Configuration revision mismatch
Problem: Source YAML, inherited/effective YAML, WebGUI edits, staged YAML, and executed MATLAB configuration may diverge.
RequiredFix: Bind every run to one immutable ResolvedRunConfiguration and SHA-256; execute only the staged resolved YAML.
Acceptance: Source/effective/resolved/executed hashes reconcile exactly and the command manifest names the exact staged file.

Title: No single simulation context
Problem: Carrier, BWP, numerology, arrays, state stores, seeds, output paths, and profile metadata may be recreated locally.
RequiredFix: Create one immutable SimulationContext and dependency-injected ComponentRegistry.
Acceptance: No production subsystem constructs a second carrier/clock/config/seed service outside the registry.

Title: Distributed time bases
Problem: Frame, slot, symbol, sample, K0/K1/K2, measurement age, channel updates, and protocol timers may use separate counters.
RequiredFix: Create one AbsoluteRadioClock and event scheduler with produced-at, available-at, consumed-at time.
Acceptance: All cross-layer events reconcile to absolute sample/symbol time; no future-state consumption is possible.

Title: Waveform path duplication
Problem: Control, data, reference-signal, fixed-link, and geometry paths may use different OFDM or waveform implementations.
RequiredFix: Route every channel through the implemented canonical waveform engine and continuous stream state.
Acceptance: The waveform implementation/version digest is identical across modes and all channels for equivalent configurations.

Title: Fixed-link grant bypass
Problem: The SNR sweep can use configured grants and later be interpreted as connected-network evidence.
RequiredFix: Separate CALIBRATION_GRANT and CONNECTED_DECODED_GRANT subprofiles. Calibration may use explicit grants but cannot satisfy control/network gates.
Acceptance: At least one fixed-SNR connected smoke test uses decoded PDCCH/DCI and decoded UCI; calibration artifacts are clearly isolated.

Title: Configured state overrides decoded state
Problem: Geometry execution can allow scheduler/configured grants, CSI, ACK, RRC, or beam truth to override decoded receiver state.
RequiredFix: Add a GrantCausalityLedger and event-sourced state ownership checks.
Acceptance: Dynamic PDSCH/PUSCH/HARQ/MCS/beam updates occur only after the corresponding decoded event and valid availability time.

Title: SNR reference-plane ambiguity
Problem: Configured SNR may be applied at inconsistent points relative to precoding, OFDM, channel, RF, and receiver noise.
RequiredFix: Define one FixedLinkNoiseReference contract and one analytical noise-scaling service.
Acceptance: Configured SNR, measured input SNR, and post-equalization SINR are separately reported and reconcile within profile tolerances.

Title: Absolute power chain divergence
Problem: Fixed mode can use normalized samples while geometry mode uses dBm/pathloss/noise figure without a shared ledger.
RequiredFix: Use the canonical absolute-power, noise, and OFDM scaling ledgers in both modes.
Acceptance: Equivalent controlled cases reconcile power to <=0.05 dB and fixed/geometry reference planes match.

Title: Channel normalization mismatch
Problem: AWGN, TDL, CDL, geometry path gain, antenna gain, and RF stages can normalize or rescale samples differently.
RequiredFix: Create an explicit ChannelApplicationContract with normalization disabled unless profile-declared and ledgered.
Acceptance: No hidden path-gain or RMS normalization remains; channel impulse/sample powers reconcile.

Title: Non-atomic resource ownership
Problem: PDCCH/PDSCH/PUSCH/PUCCH/SSB/PRACH/CSI-RS/SRS/TRS/PT-RS may be mapped by separate code before collision validation.
RequiredFix: Use one slot-level ResourceTransactionManager and RE ownership map before waveform generation.
Acceptance: Zero unauthorized RE collisions; authorized CDM/OCC sharing is explicitly identified and independently validated.

Title: Non-causal event consumption
Problem: CSI, SRS, ACK, timing, channel estimates, or future geometry state can be consumed before they are available.
RequiredFix: Every event and measurement carries ProducedAt, AvailableAt, ExpiryAt, and ConsumedAt.
Acceptance: Causality audit shows zero early-consumption events and zero stale-state uses.

Title: Incomplete measurement-to-scheduler loop
Problem: Measured CSI/SRS/RSRP/SINR may be exported but not used by the live scheduler, or configured values may remain authoritative.
RequiredFix: Connect decoded reports and measured sounding states to the scheduler through versioned state objects.
Acceptance: Changing the measured report changes the later grant/MCS/rank/TPMI; removing it blocks or enters explicit acquisition state.

Title: Incomplete UL sounding authority
Problem: SRS-derived RI/SRI/TPMI may not equal the matrix applied to PUSCH.
RequiredFix: Carry SRS measurement ID and selected/applied precoder digests through DCI, grant, and waveform.
Acceptance: Selected and applied UL matrix digests match for every supported case; stale sounding fails closed.

Title: HARQ timing and identity fragmentation
Problem: HARQ process, TB, codeword, NDI epoch, RV, feedback timing, and soft-buffer state can diverge between layers.
RequiredFix: Use one HARQ identity and central K1/K2 timing service across PHY and MAC.
Acceptance: No TB identity mismatch, wrong RV combine, duplicate delivery, or feedback outside the exact opportunity.

Title: RF state discontinuity
Problem: CFO, timing, SCO, phase noise, AGC, filtering, and resampling state can reset at slot or mode boundaries.
RequiredFix: Carry persistent RF and waveform stream state in SimulationContext.
Acceptance: One-shot and chunked runs match; no phase/sample discontinuity occurs at slot, frame, carrier, or mode-adapter boundaries.

Title: Scalar interference shortcut
Problem: Geometry mode can use scalar SINR/interference while fixed mode uses waveform samples.
RequiredFix: Build a sample-domain MultiLinkInterferenceGraph and compose every desired/interfering contribution before the receiver.
Acceptance: Composite samples equal the per-link sum; covariance and per-link powers reconcile.

Title: Mobility/channel discontinuity
Problem: Geometry, LOS/LSP, CDL/TDL coefficients, Doppler phase, blockage, and serving-cell state can update on unrelated cadences.
RequiredFix: Use one immutable geometry/channel state trace and continuous update scheduler.
Acceptance: Position, delay, Doppler, phase, LSP, and channel coefficients remain continuous within declared model events.

Title: MIMO/beam state not applied end-to-end
Problem: Reported RI/PMI/beam/TCI state may not match data, DM-RS, PT-RS, or receiver processing.
RequiredFix: Carry matrix/beam/TCI identities through grant, grid, waveform, channel, and receiver.
Acceptance: Selected/applied matrix and beam digests reconcile; rank/port/layer collapse count is zero.

Title: MAC-to-PHY lineage gaps
Problem: Packets, MAC SDUs/PDUs, TBs, codewords, HARQ attempts, and first delivery can lose identity across the integrated path.
RequiredFix: Use immutable cross-layer lineage and conservation ledger.
Acceptance: Arrived = queued + inflight + delivered + dropped; unowned and duplicate-delivered bytes are zero.

Title: Protocol profile leakage
Problem: Simplified protocol-study behavior can be mixed into strict PHY/system runs.
RequiredFix: Keep nr_rel18_system_lls_strict, protocol_system_study, and rel20_6g_study_context physically and semantically separate.
Acceptance: Artifacts and gates never inherit a PHY pass into a protocol or 6G normative claim.

Title: Seed/substream inconsistency
Problem: Mode-specific RNG, global rand/randn, retries, and parallel workers can change results.
RequiredFix: Create one SeedLedger with deterministic task/substream assignment.
Acceptance: Same task and seed are bit-reproducible; different independent drops are statistically independent.

Title: Parallel merge non-determinism
Problem: Task completion order, retries, duplicate IDs, or floating-point reduction order can change aggregate results.
RequiredFix: Use immutable TaskIDs and canonical deterministic merge with conflict detection and stable summation.
Acceptance: Serial, parallel, shuffled, and retried campaigns produce identical canonical outputs and hashes.

Title: No cross-mode reduction test
Problem: There is no proof that geometry mode reduces to fixed-link behavior when geometry/interference are neutralized.
RequiredFix: Add AWGN and TDL cross-mode equivalence scenarios with identical payloads, grants, noise/channel samples, and receiver chain.
Acceptance: Controlled cross-mode cases recover identical bits and waveform/receiver digests; aggregate metrics match exactly or within predeclared tolerance.

Title: Mode-specific KPI semantic drift
Problem: SNR, SINR, throughput, BLER, goodput, latency, and energy can have different denominators/time windows in each mode.
RequiredFix: Create one KPI registry and sample ledger with run-class applicability and named time windows.
Acceptance: The same KPI name has one unit, numerator, denominator, phase, and provenance across modes.

Title: Fragmented artifact schemas
Problem: Each phase emits outputs with different IDs, paths, keys, or completeness semantics.
RequiredFix: Create one IntegrationArtifactExporter and per-run manifest referencing all domain artifacts by opaque ID and hash.
Acceptance: Every required artifact is indexed, schema-valid, non-stale, and linked to its generating run/config/source data.

Title: WebGUI/run mismatch
Problem: Run-mode dropdown, YAML editor, scenario selection, and displayed results can refer to different revisions or runs.
RequiredFix: Bind the WebGUI request to ConfigRevisionID, RunID, mode/profile, and artifact manifest.
Acceptance: The selected run and exact executed configuration are visible on every Results/Validation page; no substring run lookup.

Title: Failure/restart inconsistency
Problem: Partial runs, graceful stop, worker loss, and resume can leave mutated state or misleading completed outputs.
RequiredFix: Add checkpointable run state, atomic output staging, partial status, and restart reconciliation.
Acceptance: A failed/stopped run is never marked complete; resumed/retried work is idempotent and does not double count.

Title: Unbounded runtime/memory growth
Problem: Per-RE/per-sample/per-event traces can exhaust memory or silently disable fidelity.
RequiredFix: Implement streaming/chunked processing, bounded trace policies, backpressure, and explicit full/summary trace modes.
Acceptance: Acceptance runs complete within configured hardware budgets without fidelity downgrade or dropped mandatory evidence.

Title: No actual two-mode acceptance suite
Problem: Subsystem tests can pass without actual fixed-SNR and moving multi-cell geometry runs.
RequiredFix: Add smoke, cross-mode, and full acceptance scenarios and require fresh MATLAB execution.
Acceptance: Both canonical modes complete actual runs, generate all mandatory artifacts, and pass integration gates on the pinned toolchain.

Title: 5G strict and 6G study claim mixing
Problem: A 6G study option can be presented as strict production conformance.
RequiredFix: Make run mode orthogonal to radio profile; NR strict and Release-20 study share infrastructure but have separate support/gate semantics.
Acceptance: Release-20 outputs are marked Normative=false and cannot satisfy NR strict or conformance gates.
